name: buildwithdarius-ai

creator.name: Nam Học AI
creator.niche: Kỹ năng AI (edit video, làm nội dung, làm việc hiệu quả) cho người Việt mới bắt đầu, chỉ từng bước bằng tiếng Việt

notes: Paper only all along (layout seam 1920): no camera card. The screen recording, when used, is a white window card on the paper (actor with media), never full screen.

Frame: assets/components/steps.html (hook title, progress bar, 'Bước n' kicker, serif step title with an italic accent word), captured --alpha for the whole short and wired as an overlay from 0. Edit window.TUT from files/words.md (short times).

One step = one title + ONE main card under it (y 450 to 1350): a real UI rebuilt (term for Claude Code, a browser window, app cards with real logos). The card changes state on the words, it never sits still.
Motion: soft. Everything blurs in (.35 s) and blurs out (.25 s), no slide, no bounce, no hard cut, no zoom on the paper.
Captions: black Inter 700 about 46 px at y 1460, 2 to 3 words, each word blurs in when said; emph = the accent color on the key words (tool names, the step's verb).
Sound: voice only. No music, no sound effects (the original's silences are pure digital silence). Keep about .4 s of silence between sentences, the pace breathes.
Hook: kicker 'Hướng dẫn cho người mới' in accent caps, 2 to 3 big serif lines centered, the last one italic in the accent with a drawn underline. Then a big number ('chỉ 3 bước').
CTA: 'Comment' in big serif, the keyword in white bold on an accent rounded button, then 2 to 4 white chips with real logos of what they get.
Comment word: one keyword per video, tied to that video's guide (e.g. EDIT). No emoji on screen or in captions.
Never Instrument Serif, Poppins, DM Sans or Archivo Black: no Vietnamese diacritics. Serif = Noto Serif Display condensed (assets/fonts), sans = Inter.
